about: Hands (scripts/melee.gd). Times are seconds, distances metres, wind out of 100. A punch `lands` that long after it starts and is over after `time`; it costs the thrower `wind` and takes `hurts` off the other man's. A slip lasts `time`; a punch that arrives during it misses, and for `counter` seconds his next punch hurts `gain` times as much. A jab on a man whose hands are up (not mid-punch himself, and not after a slip) does only `guarded` of its harm; a hook goes through. `people` says who will fight: `heart` 0.5 or more squares up when hit (below, he runs), `hands` 0 .. 1 is how often and how well he throws, `wind` is how much he has. Every number is a placeholder, written on 2026-11-15, not the owners'.
